entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
Sea Ceptor is the primary air-defence weapon system onboard Royal New Zealand Navy Anzac-class frigates, HMNZ ships Te Mana and Te Kaha. The system protects not only the frigate but vessels it is sailing with against advanced supersonic anti-ship missiles, aircraft and drones at ranges exceeding 25km.
 
We operate guided missiles across maritime, land and air domains. The anti-ship, anti-armour and anti-air capabilities are controlled by trained sailors, soldiers and aviators across the services.
 
Explore our missile systems ➡️ nzdf.mil.nz/missile-systems
